mapper.select: SELECT a.*,c.title AS course_title,c.status AS course_status,s.status AS my_status, CASE WHEN #{role}='mentor' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission p WHERE p.assignment_id=a.id AND p.status='SUBMITTED') ELSE NULL END AS pending_count FROM assignment a JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=a.course_id LEFT JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{userId} WHERE c.deleted=0 AND a.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM learning_enrollment e WHERE e.course_id=c.id AND e.student_id=#{userId} AND e.active=1) AND c.mentor_id=#{userId} AND #{role}='mentor' AND LOCATE(#{keyword},a.title)>0 AND a.course_id=#{courseId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignment_submission p WHERE p.assignment_id=a.id AND p.status='SUBMITTED') ORDER BY a.id DESC
SELECT a.*,c.title AS course_title,c.status AS course_status FROM assignment a JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=a.course_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND c.deleted=0
SELECT * FROM assignment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment SET title=#{title},instructions=#{instructions},status=#{status},due_at=#{dueAt},max_score=#{maxScore},language_code=#{languageCode},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assignment_submission s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.student_id WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND s.student_id=#{studentId}
SELECT * FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM assignment_submission s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.student_id WHERE s.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_submission SET answer_text=#{answerText},status=#{status},attempt_no=#{attemptNo},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM assignment_submission s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.student_id JOIN assignment a ON a.id=s.assignment_id JOIN learning_course c ON c.id=a.course_id WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND s.attempt_no>0 AND c.mentor_id=#{mentorId} AND c.deleted=0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.status='SUBMITTED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,s.update_time DESC,s.id
SELECT * FROM assignment_attempt WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC
SELECT * FROM assignment_attempt WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_attempt SET status=#{status},score=#{score},feedback=#{feedback},reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy},reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt} WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo} AND status='SUBMITTED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assignment_file WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND deleted=0 AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}AND attempt_no IS NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM assignment_file WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_file SET deleted=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND attempt_no IS NULL
UPDATE assignment_file SET attempt_no=#{attemptNo} WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND attempt_no IS NULL AND deleted=0
